about_the_game:
Belle Citique is a joyful, comfortable citybuilder which places you into a beautiful world, surrounded by the marvel of nature. Slowly build your settlement, combining different block-types to create anything you can imagine, and bringing more residents and animals to your little paradise. Welcome to your happy haven!

FEATURES

  • Attract villagers and animals to your city and watch them enjoy all your hard work. New residents bring new ideas and possibilities! More and more arrive as you build, and they offer suggestions or compliments about their home!

  • Relaxing building experience without dangers or disruption. The calm beauty of nature is your companion and encouragement.

  • Fulfill construction objectives to unlock new biomes and maps, as well as new block-types to build with. 

  • Complex yet intuitive grid-based building system allows you to combine different blocks to create anything you can imagine: parks and plazas, towers and town-centers. 

  • Customize colors and designs to make your city a true reflection of you!

A BEAUTIFUL CITY ATTRACTS HAPPY RESIDENTS

Take a break for a while! Sit back and watch your villagers enjoying their lives in the city you’ve built for them! How do they spend their days in your parks and marketplaces? What does it feel like to walk your streets? And what about the animals out in the wilderness, enjoying the forests and the rivers, with your beautiful city as decoration in the distance? There’s no stress here!

ENDLESS POSSIBILITY



Use the grid to guide the rough shapes and outlines of your buildings; but the grid is only the starting point! Watch how your structures shift and adapt to the natural terrain around them, stilting up and down hills or arching over rivers and roads to create beautiful tunnels and gates. Discover different block-combinations sprouting into plazas and towers! Carefully sculpt the surrounding world itself, creating waterfalls and sprawling meadows!

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 11
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Additional Notes: A mouse with a scroll wheel and button is needed for full camera control.

name: Belle Citique

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: 2 GHz Intel Core i3 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: A mouse with a scroll wheel and button is needed for full camera control.

short_description: Construct a cozy society one building at a time in Belle Citique, a warmhearted citybuilder. Build the perfect place for your people to live, and enjoy them enjoying their lives. Do things your way, according to your own vision!
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese - Brazil, Simplified Chinese
